digest.component_or_area: LLM provider configuration and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-*') maps to 'google_genai', which is not recognized by pydantic-ai's known providers or ProviderSession builders, causing provider construction to fail at runtime
bare gemini-* model ids are unusable because the inferred provider name cannot be resolved, though the config appears valid at construction time
model_classes._resolve_target uses inferred provider names verbatim without verification, composing invalid provider:model strings that fail only at call time
mapping gemini to google (pydantic-ai's canonical Gemini Developer API provider name) resolves the issue while maintaining compatibility with existing explicit model_provider overrides
every entry in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map to a provider known to both pydantic-ai and ProviderSession to prevent future similar defects
